title: Treaty of Stuhmsdorf
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Stuhmsdorf", at revision 1301365645, opens: "The Treaty of Stuhmsdorf, was signed on 12 September 1635 in Sztumska Wieś, Poland, between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Sweden. With the latter weakened by its involvement in the Thirty Years' War, it extended the 1629 Truce of Altmark for 26+1⁄2 years, with Sweden making significant concessions." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q573173, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "peace treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
